shots.name: 01-zoomed-out-state-pips
shots.after: { const h = hillinkWorld.theme.layout.home; hillinkWorld.camera.focusPoint(h.x + h.w / 2, h.y + h.h / 2, { zoom: 0.8, duration: 0 }); } true

shots.name: 03-picking-up-task-at-board
shots.after: { const e = hillinkWorld.scene.get('agent:claude'); hillinkWorld.camera.focusPoint(e.x, e.y - e.h / 2, { zoom: 2.6, duration: 0 }); } true

shots.name: 04-carrying-task-to-desk
shots.after: { const e = hillinkWorld.scene.get('agent:claude'); hillinkWorld.camera.focusPoint(e.x, e.y - e.h / 2, { zoom: 2.6, duration: 0 }); } true

shots.name: 05-blocked-frustrated-red-screen
shots.eval: setTimeout(() => hillinkWorld.sim.run('claudeCodes'), 300); window.__blk = setInterval(() => { const e = hillinkWorld.scene.get('agent:claude'); if (e?.anim?.state === 'type' && !window.__blocked) { window.__blocked = true; setTimeout(() => hillinkWorld.sim.emit('TASK_BLOCKED', { taskId: hillinkWorld.store.world.agents.claude.taskId ?? e.agent.taskId, detail: 'Needs Kyle: production SQL approval (simulated)' }), 2500); } }, 100); true

shots.name: 06-filing-finished-task-at-archive
shots.eval: setTimeout(() => hillinkWorld.sim.run('claudeCodes'), 300); window.__fin = setInterval(() => { const e = hillinkWorld.scene.get('agent:claude'); if (e?.anim?.state === 'type' && !window.__done) { window.__done = true; setTimeout(() => { hillinkWorld.sim.run('taskCompletes'); setTimeout(() => hillinkWorld.sim.allIdle(), 3000); }, 2000); } }, 100); true
